An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 6 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 6 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
